scope: Diagnostic attribution and component references; not optimization confirmation or promotion
hypotheses: Phase-level dispatch and address/context exposure will identify whether integer, JSON, SHA and loopback HTTP require different optimization targets.
Existing translation/interpreter/helper/memory counters plus bounded PC/edge and syscall exposure can narrow unexplained costs without treating nested counters as exclusive time fractions.
Direct WASM integer and SHA components will establish practical component references and expose guard/copy interface costs.

guest.workloadPolicy: Import unchanged source; use new explicitly identified M1 ACK protocol

independentUnit: Fresh browser and guest capture per mode; repeated phase batches are nested, not independent launches
followupPolicy: Retain every pilot and failure. Correctness or incomplete coverage requires a new labeled run. Additional repetitions are exploratory and must not be pooled into a frozen confirmation.

timing.endpoint: Start ACK/continuation through receipt of the result marker, with the exact stop/read boundary documented by the runner
timing.controlOverhead: Report empty gates and stopped diagnostic-read intervals separately; do not subtract calibration from the primary endpoint
timing.counterMeaning: Dispatch/PC/edge/syscall exposure is not guest instruction retirement or a fraction of elapsed time; existing helper/interpreter/translation timers may nest

directReferences.integer: Exact dependent i32 recurrence, arbitrary seeds/counts/constants plus named original workload
directReferences.sha: Arbitrary-state compression and synchronous full SHA256; named 65536-byte pattern times 16
directReferences.host: Use same installed Chrome for browser component and guest observations; Node correctness is separate
directReferences.memory: Standalone wasm32 component reference differs from VM memory64 ABI and is labeled explicitly
directReferences.equivalenceLimits: No standalone JSON parser or in-memory exchange is claimed equivalent to Bun object creation or guest HTTP

validation: Exact original workload results and all gate ordering/identity checks
Pinned source, toolchain, runtime, bundle, guest assets and harness identities
Bounded/resettable profile data with documented drops, sampling and estimation error
Arbitrary-input integer and SHA oracle agreement, bounds, alias and cancellation contracts
Owned process cleanup and unchanged retained production runtimes

analysis.primaryOutput: Per-phase exposure, descriptive perturbation ratios, direct versus bridge component costs, provenance and ranked next hypotheses
analysis.uncertainty: One independent launch per mode cannot establish a confidence interval, equivalence, or a percent-level performance improvement
